caption: The drawing depicts a square textile design composed of smaller diamond-shaped sections arranged in a grid pattern. Each diamond contains a distinct motif, with alternating patterns. Some diamonds are filled with green and red floral patterns featuring symmetrical leaves and flowers, predominantly using green, red, and touches of blue, while others display individual objects. These objects include potted trees with green foliage and peach-colored fruits, bouquets of multicolored flowers in vases, a wreath with floral embellishments, a pair of circular motifs containing crescent moons and stars, and a central diamond depicting a yellow house with a red roof, flanked by green trees and a small figure on a horse-drawn carriage. Blue floral clusters are located at the intersections of the diamonds on the border. The background color of the textile design is a light beige or off-white, and the overall composition features a regular, repeating structure with elements that combine natural and architectural motifs.
title: Embroidered Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
